ToolUsageEntry.description: One MCP tool's offered-vs-called record, qualified ``<server>.<tool>``.

called_cells.description: Cells that called it at least once (not total calls)
called_cells.title: Called Cells

engines.description: Calls per engine — a tool used by one engine and not another is usually a prompt or sandbox difference, not a tool problem
engines.title: Engines

offered_cells.description: Cells whose manifest advertised this tool — the denominator. 0 means no cell recorded it as offered, which on logs predating the offered-tools record means unknown rather than not-offered
offered_cells.title: Offered Cells

ToolUsageEntry.title: ToolUsageEntry

description:
The offered-vs-called tool rollup over every committed retrieval log.

Answers which configured tools are actually earning their place. A zero in
``calls`` means **never called** — not useless: the prompt may never mention
the tool, or a sandbox may have blocked it, and this data cannot separate
those from genuine uselessness. Read it beside ``offered_cells``.

builtin_calls.description: Calls to engine built-ins (shell, file IO, web search), counted separately because they are not what the manifest offers
builtin_calls.title: Builtin Calls

entries.description: Offered-but-never-called first, then by descending calls — the actionable rows lead
entries.title: Entries

logs_without_offered_record.description: Logs carrying no `mcp_tools` (written before the field existed), so they contribute calls but no offered denominator
logs_without_offered_record.title: Logs Without Offered Record

offered_now.description: What the CURRENT manifest advertises, server-qualified. Supplies a denominator for logs written before per-cell `mcp_tools` existed; a tool listed here with no calls is genuinely never-called, while one called but absent here ran under an older pin
offered_now.title: Offered Now

pins.description: Logs per `<id>=<pinned package>` the cells actually ran under. Read it beside `offered_now`: when they name different versions, the offered set is today's and the calls are from an older server
pins.title: Pins
